Issue 5, 2016

NOW AVAILABLE

We've rolled out improvements across the product
family, including in the Wolfram Cloud, to take
advantage of new Wolfram Language functionality
and compatibility with Mathematica 10.4.

CDF Player 10.4 »
Bring documents to life with interactivity and powerful computation.

gridMathematica 10.4 »
Multiply the power of Mathematica over the grid to easily control
CPUs and GPUs and solve large problems fast.

Mathematica 10.4 Simplified Chinese Edition »
Get access to the full Mathematica interface translated into Chinese,
including all-new features introduced in Mathematica 10.4.

SPECIAL OFFERS

Mathematics Awareness Month Deals »
Do the math and save on select Wolfram products, including
Mathematica Student and Home Editions. Offers are good
through April 30, 2016.

EFTA00693126

 FEATURED HIGHLIGHTS

New Wolfram SystemModeler Examples »
We've added dozens of new examples across multiple industries
and educational disciplines to demonstrate how easy it is to use
SystemModeler's modeling and simulation functionality. Explore
the list and download full models on our website.

TRENDING TOPICS

LEGO, SCOTUS, Minecraft, and More! »
Check out what Wolfram Community members are up to.
From LEGO versions of plots and scans to recreating
Minecraft's classic game functionality, people are doing fun
and inspiring things with the Wolfram Language.

JUST POSTED

New Wolfram Technologies Books Bring
Computation to STEM »
Recently published books prove to be invaluable resources for
hobbyists, STEM professionals, and students in a variety of fields.
Visit the blog for the complete list of new titles and detailed book
descriptions.

FROM THE EXPERTS

Homework to Hackathons Virtual Event »
Back by popular demand. Join us April 21 for this free
rebroadcast and see how you can take your tech to the next
level. Presentations are designed especially for engineering
students, but all will benefit. Space is limited, so register today.
